slug.description: 12-char base32 truncated SHA256 of normalized command

parsed.description: bashlex AST as JSON, null if parsing failed

parsed_error.description: Parse error message when parsed is null

decoded_layers.description: Decode layers as a breadth-first tree in discovery order. `layer` is the depth; `parent` is the 1-based index of the layer it was decoded from (0 = the pasted command).

encoding.description: Decoder label, e.g. base64-utf16le, base64-gzip, cmd-caret, powershell-index, limit-reached

lolbas_match.description: Matching LOLBAS entry if a known-abusable binary was found, else null
